metadata.title: FUNNIEST Bloopers & Behind the Scenes of JHARKHAND FOOD SERIES
metadata.description:
We are wrapping up the super entertaining and immersive Jharkhand Food Series with some hilarious behind the scene moments that reminds us of the jocular time we had experienced during this enriching gastronomic expedition across the state.

We are extremely thankful to our magnificent audience, hosts and everyone else who has been a part of this journey, for the grand success of this gratifying series. Stay connected as we bring you more such amazing experiences from far and near. Till then keep walking and keep exploring. 

Hope you enjoy these funny scenes that didn't make it to the main videos.
